items.caption: A modern small-seal-style rendering of 山 has a rounded U-shaped outer contour with two tall side uprights. A taller central stem forks into two diagonal arms that meet the inner sides of the contour near the bottom.
items.alt: A rounded U-shaped outline rises into two tall side uprights. Inside it, a taller central stem forks into two diagonals that meet the outline near the bottom.
items.selection_reason: The outline and branching central stem make this modern redraw useful for showing one small-seal-style form of 山. Its shape illustrates the graph without implying a stroke sequence or dated transition.
items.period: Seal-script tradition; specimen date not established

limitations.text: This is a modern digital redraw in small-seal style, not an ancient inscription image. It shows a later graphic form but does not establish a specimen date or a continuous sequence of graphic changes.
